title: Pennsylvania Sen. Doug Mastriano joins Manitowoc’s Veterans Day celebration
summary: The event at the Company’s Shady Grove manufacturing facility honored Manitowoc veterans and highlighted the work of its Veteran Employee Resource Group (VERG).Manitowoc also recently earned recognition as a 2026 Military Times “Best for Vets” Employer for the third consecutive year.
body_markdown:
- The event at the Company’s Shady Grove manufacturing facility honored Manitowoc veterans and highlighted the work of its Veteran Employee Resource Group (VERG).
- Manitowoc also recently earned recognition as a 2026 Military Times “Best for Vets” Employer for the third consecutive year.


Manitowoc welcomed Pennsylvania state Sen. Doug Mastriano to its manufacturing facility in Shady Grove, Pa., where he joined employees earlier this month at a special Veterans Day lunch honoring veterans across the organization.


The event brought employees and veterans together to recognize their service and sacrifice and celebrate the contributions they make at Manitowoc. Mastriano, who represents Pennsylvania’s 33rd Senate District, is a retired U.S. Army colonel and combat veteran. He chairs the Pennsylvania Senate Veterans Affairs and Emergency Preparedness Committee and addressed employees during the celebration.


“It was a tremendous honor to be part of Manitowoc’s Veterans Day celebration in Shady Grove. Manitowoc’s commitment to honoring those who have served, including through its Veteran Employee Resource Group (VERG), speaks volumes about the value they place on their veteran employees and their service. Thank you to Manitowoc for making our veterans feel valued and appreciated, and most importantly, thank you to all who have served. Your sacrifice, courage, and continued contributions will never be forgotten,” Mastriano said.


During the celebration, VERG Chair Heather Monn highlighted the group’s recent accomplishments and shared its goals for the future. She was joined by fellow VERG members John Merx and Dave Courtney, who support initiatives focused on recognizing, connecting, and engaging Manitowoc’s veteran community.


“As a veteran, it means a great deal to work for a company that genuinely values those who have served,” Monn said. “At Manitowoc, that support goes beyond saying, ‘thank you for your service.’ It’s about creating opportunities, providing resources, and giving veterans a voice within our organization. Through VERG, we’re building a stronger community for veterans while recognizing the unique experience and perspective they bring to Manitowoc every day.”


The celebration comes as Manitowoc marks its third consecutive year as a Military Times “[Best for Vets” Employer](https://bestforvets.militarytimes.com/employers/2026/?ranking_search=manitowoc) . The annual ranking evaluates employers based on their policies, practices, and benefits supporting veterans and their families.


[View the 2026 Military Times “Best for Vets” Employer rankings](https://bestforvets.militarytimes.com/employers/2026/?ranking_search=manitowoc) .
